name: oid4vci-issuer
description: A minimal OID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) issuer service. Content-agnostic: takes an already-built unsigned Verifiable Credential from a coordinator, runs the pre-authorized-code/token/credential protocol with the wallet, and signs it either as an SD-JWT (vc+sd-jwt) with its own key or, for ldp_vc, via a digitalcredentials/signing-service instance.
author: Samuel Rinnetmäki <samuel@iki.fi>
